environment: Linux cloud sandbox, Node v22.23.4. Apizie booted from the repository (createApp, MemoryKV storage) on 127.0.0.1 over plain HTTP. Upstream: recording stub for full-catalog execution; real internet only for hosts the sandbox egress allows (registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org, crates.io; api.github.com answers 401/403). Client: official MCP TypeScript SDK 1.32.2 (StreamableHTTPClientTransport) and Claude Code CLI 2.1.311.
mcp_endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:<ephemeral-port>/mcp (Streamable HTTP, stateless, JSON responses; auth via x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer; credentials omitted)

mcp_discovery_before_fix.note: search_scrapers returned nextCursor but ignored it; no tool listed an API's endpoint slugs, so get_scraper_schema could not be called without guessing

notes: operations_tested = every operation that can run without provider credentials (status live), each invoked once through MCP run_scraper against a recording stub upstream. Passed = MCP success envelope plus exactly the expected upstream request(s) to a valid public URL.

123 native operations sent a correct upstream request but their handler rejected the stub's empty {} body; response parsing is not verified by this run. Roughly 40% of them (31 sources in total) also have recorded-fixture tests in test/scrapers; the rest need a live run.
16 operations need one of several optional fields (e.g. id or bundleId); they passed once the documented examples were sent.
7 operations compute locally (uuid, hash, slugify, terbilang, qibla) and correctly make no upstream call.
Blocked: finance:fred (10 operations) needs FRED_API_KEY on the server; cloud:climatekuul (26) runs on port 8000, which the SSRF guard refuses by design.

Credential-gated: 36541 byok operations were invoked without a provider key: 36535 returned a clean upstream_key_required error with zero upstream calls; 6 returned invalid_params first because the provider's spec example values do not satisfy its own schema. Execution with real keys was not possible (no provider credentials).
Not live: all 936 planned operations returned 501 not_live (936/936) and were not billed.
Input validation: missing required 7450/7450, bad enum 1062/1062, wrong type 2644/2644 rejected as invalid_params with field errors; upstream called on invalid input: 0.
Host pinning: 8987 directory upstream requests all stayed on the provider's spec base URL (violations: 0).

Live upstream (real internet): 24 read-only operations attempted on reachable hosts; 6 returned real non-empty data (npm 2/2, PyPI 2/2, crates.io 2/2); 18 GitHub operations were refused by api.github.com from this sandbox (401/403), an environment limit. A repeated call was served from cache without a second upstream request: true.

details.generic_mcp_client: Official MCP TypeScript SDK 1.32.2: initialize (negotiated 2025-11-25), ping, tools/list (8 tools, all inputSchemas compile with Ajv), tools/call for every tool, full catalog and schema enumeration.
details.claude: Claude Code CLI 2.1.311 in print mode with --mcp-config (type http, x-api-key header): the model used search_scrapers -> get_scraper_schema (list) -> get_scraper_schema (endpoint) -> run_scraper and answered 'express 5.3.0' via search-tools:npm (6 turns, success). Server-side get_usage for that key showed exactly 1 billed call. Run happened after the discovery fixes (QA-001/002) and before the later error-classification fixes.
details.codex: Codex CLI is not installed in the test environment and no OpenAI credentials are available. Not claimed.

defects.root_cause: Tool returned nextCursor but did not accept or forward a cursor, so every page was page 1; only 956/1,901 sources (50.3%) were reachable even via per-category searches.
defects.fix_applied: Added cursor and status inputs, forward cursor to catalog.list, stable ordering, slim items, honour admin-disabled status.
defects.regression_test: test/mcp-qa.test.js: search_scrapers pages through the whole catalog with cursor

defects.root_cause: No MCP tool returned an API's endpoint slugs; get_scraper_schema required an endpoint slug, so operations were not discoverable (0 of 47,141).
defects.fix_applied: endpoint is now optional: without it the tool lists the API's endpoints (slug, name, method, upstream method, status, plan) with cursor paging; tool count stays 8.
defects.regression_test: test/mcp-qa.test.js: get_scraper_schema without endpoint lists every operation

defects.root_cause: schemaFields ignored the directory field location (src), reporting every parameter of non-GET operations as body and header parameters as query; the upstream verb (e.g. DELETE) was hidden behind POST.
defects.fix_applied: Use src for location; expose upstreamMethod in detail, schema and endpoint list.
defects.regression_test: test/mcp-qa.test.js: schema reports the real parameter location and upstream method

defects.root_cause: 259 operations in 12 imported APIs use {placeholders} the spec never declares, so the schema omitted them and every call failed with 'Missing path parameter'.
defects.fix_applied: At load time, undeclared path placeholders become required string path fields.
defects.regression_test: test/mcp-qa.test.js: undeclared {path} placeholders become required path fields

defects.root_cause: A DNS failure (or SSRF-guard refusal) for the provider's own host was thrown as ScraperError -> HTTP 400 invalid_params and billed.
defects.fix_applied: Spec-host DNS failures and guard refusals map to 502 (not billed) with a clear message.
defects.regression_test: test/mcp-qa.test.js: upstream DNS failure, 5xx and handler crashes are 502; provider host the SSRF guard refuses is a 502

defects.root_cause: Native handlers reported network failures, upstream 5xx and 429 as ScraperError -> billed HTTP 400 invalid_params.
defects.fix_applied: New UpstreamError: unreachable/5xx -> 502 (not billed), 429 -> 429 with Retry-After; 4xx stays a ScraperError.

defects.root_cause: A handler crashing on an unexpected upstream payload (TypeError) returned a generic 500 Internal error.
defects.fix_applied: TypeError/SyntaxError from handlers become 502 'returned an unexpected response' (or 'could not be reached'), logged as warnings.

defects.root_cause: Results over 120,000 characters were cut mid-JSON with no structuredContent, so agents could not parse them (seen live on PyPI 'requests').
defects.fix_applied: Shrink to valid JSON (long strings, then largest arrays/maps halved) with a _truncated note and structuredContent.
defects.regression_test: test/mcp-qa.test.js: oversized tool results are shortened to valid JSON

defects.root_cause: Unsupported MCP-Protocol-Version header was accepted (spec requires 400).
defects.fix_applied: Reject unsupported header values with 400 and the supported list.

defects.root_cause: Malformed JSON on /mcp produced a REST error envelope instead of JSON-RPC -32700.
defects.fix_applied: On /mcp, body parse errors return JSON-RPC Parse error (-32700) and oversized bodies -32600.

defects.root_cause: Bodies over 1 MB aborted the read loop, resetting the connection before the 413 was sent.
defects.fix_applied: Drain (without buffering) up to 16 MB so the client receives 413.

defects.root_cause: 66 Google (googleapis.com) and Amadeus specs omit their security scheme, so the catalog advertised them as keyless 'live' although both providers require credentials.
defects.fix_applied: Known-provider auth override: Google -> API key in ?key=, Amadeus -> bearer token; now listed as byok (live sources 629 -> 563).
defects.regression_test: test/mcp-qa.test.js: Google and Amadeus APIs are listed as needing the caller's key

defects.root_cause: Provider 4xx answers were labelled invalid_params and 501/502 had the generic code 'error', so agents could not tell bad input from provider failures.
defects.fix_applied: upstream_error for provider errors, not_live (501), upstream_unavailable (502); existing codes unchanged.

security_results: PASS SEC-AUTH: IP allowlist enforced on MCP
PASS EXEC-004: byok: provider key forwarded upstream only on that call
PASS EXEC-004: byok: another user without key is not served the cached result
PASS EXEC-004: byok: same user without key is not served the keyed cache entry
PASS SEC-SECRETS: provider key never stored (full KV dump scanned)
PASS SEC-SECRETS: Apizie API keys stored only hashed/sealed (no plaintext in KV)
PASS SEC-INJECT: untrusted upstream text is returned as data only; server takes no further action
PASS SEC-INPUT: path-traversal style project key rejected (404)
PASS SEC-SSRF: path parameter cannot redirect request to another host
PASS SEC-SECRETS: logs never contain provider key
PASS SEC-AUTHZ: admin-disabled source shown as disabled and cannot be run

Open (LOW): Origin header is not validated on /mcp (CORS *). Risk is limited because every call needs an API key or OAuth bearer token that a third-party page cannot read, but the MCP spec asks servers to validate Origin; see remaining_blockers.

performance_results.conditions: Single Node process hosting both server and client on the sandbox, MemoryKV, stub upstream unless stated. Latencies are client-observed wall time in ms.
performance_results.concurrency: 50 concurrent run_scraper calls from 2 users: usage counted exactly (+30/+20), logs isolated; 3 concurrent real calls (npm, PyPI, crates.io) finished in 271 ms.
performance_results.memory: 755 MB RSS for server + client after loading all 1,454 directory APIs' operations (production loads them lazily per instance).
performance_results.retries: No automatic upstream retries (one attempt per call, verified for 5xx, network error and 429); timeouts enforced per endpoint (default 25 s, verified with a 1.5 s override -> 504).
performance_results.targets: No documented service objectives exist, so no pass/fail thresholds were applied.

remaining_blockers.reason: Upstream spec data quality; billing of 4xx is the documented refund policy.
remaining_blockers.required_action: Optional: drop invalid examples at import; review whether invalid-input calls should be free.
